<!-- Generated by wp-custom-agent-skills scripts/build-bundles.mjs from commands/cp-spec.md. Do not edit here; edit the source and rebuild. -->

Invoke the `cp-specification` skill.

First run `cp-context-discovery` if no Plugin Context Record exists — a spec written
without knowing the plugin's existing surface will duplicate or contradict it.

Ask what you genuinely cannot infer, then write the spec covering all nine sections:
objective and user, surface, data model, capabilities and authorization, public API added,
i18n, compatibility (multisite / back-compat / minimum versions), acceptance criteria, and
out of scope.

Rules:

- The data model choice (option vs meta vs custom table vs transient) must be justified,
  including the `autoload` decision. It is the most expensive thing to reverse.
- Every hook, route and CLI command in §5 is permanent API. If unsure it is needed, leave
  it out — adding one later is easy, removing one is not.
- Acceptance criteria must be numbered and testable, and must include at least one
  no-permission case and one empty-state case.

Save as `SPEC-<feature>.md` and confirm with the user before planning.
